items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: met some upperclassmen because of that, one of them particularly, Bill Robbins as I remember.

ctx.x: And we had had a brief — I had overheard you talking a little bit about the music that you heard at Hamilton, and that you heard someone playing a Fats Waller record —

Well actually it was a Jelly Roll Morton record that was coming out of Carnegie Hall. So I knew it had to be upperclassmen, it wasn’t my class. We were all in South Dorm. And so I went in and I found where it was coming from and met some upperclassmen because of that, one of them particularly, Bill Robbins as I remember.
Why did you already know this music before you got to Hamilton?
